name: What's the difference between custom, semi-custom, and stock cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between custom, semi-custom, and stock cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stock cabinets are pre-manufactured in standard sizes and styles, offering the most affordable and quickest option. Semi-custom cabinets offer more choices in styles, finishes, and sizes, with some modifications possible, providing a balance of cost and personalization. Custom cabinets are built specifically for your kitchen, allowing for complete design flexibility, unique dimensions, and specialized features. They are the most expensive and take the longest to produce but offer unparalleled fit and finish. Your choice depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, and specific kitchen requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stock cabinets are standard and affordable. Semi-custom offers more options and modifications. Custom cabinets are fully tailored to your design and space, but cost more.
